Printing it as a live code was a factual error in a document whose whole argument is provenance. Replaced by `*[shortcode]#` in §8.3.3, §3.6.2, §8.14 and §11.2.2, and in lib/phone-showcase.ts. Restore the digits when the aggregator provisions the code.
Removed, not moved. The second half of `*483*77#`. Same reason as 483 above.

Removed, not moved. The SMS opt-out sender ID `STOP=22340`, likewise unprovisioned and printed three different ways across the document (22340, 22XXX). Now `[Insert sender ID]` in §8.3.3, §8.3.2 and lib/phone-showcase.ts.

Removed on the document's own logic. It was the Phase −1 KPI "engaged followers: 20,000" in §9.1.1 — a follower count, which §11.2.3 rejects as a vanity metric two sections later. Replaced by R-02 (reach share landing in the 275,570-voter deficit pool) in §11.2.0, which measures the same phase against something a voter has to do.

Removed with the role it belonged to. It was the activation threshold for a second Community Manager (§14.4, "150 inbound messages/day"). Under the repositioning, community management is Dr. Mulu's existing team's work, not a Firefly surge hire, so the role and its trigger both leave §14.4.

Not a figure of the proposal. It was "6.2s" — a First Contentful Paint measurement in a ClientPage.tsx doc comment describing the tabbed architecture that the one-page flow replaced. The comment went with the architecture it described, in the flow redesign. It surfaced here only now because the guard used to count data/section-visuals.generated.json as evidence, and that generated file carries a `"number": "6.2"` field holding the SECTION number of §6.2 — a section that still exists, still has its heading, and now carries the StrategicPillarsMatrix. The generated file is excluded from the corpus (it is derived from public/content, so indexing it made this guard circular), which re-exposed the older removal.

Not a figure of the proposal. It was the Typewriter component's default duration in MILLISECONDS (`duration = 2200`), in components/visual/SplitText.tsx. Typewriter, Scramble, WordCycler and SplitText all implement effects on the visual compaction brief's deny list — kinetic headlines and text scramble — and by the end of that pass none of them had a call site left. The file went with them.

Not a figure of the proposal. It was the WordCycler's clip height in EM ("a fixed 1.16em"), described in a comment in components/visual/SplitText.tsx. Deleted with that file for the same reason as 2200 above.

A CONFLICT, not a migration — and the reason this one needs saying out loud. §3.6.1 prints TikTok's low end as 6.5% of the register; 35,000 ÷ 532,758 is 6.5695%, which is 6.6%, and the row directly beneath prints exactly that for the same 35,000. The `platform-sizing` figure computes, so it says 6.6%. Under hard rule 2 neither number has been changed: the TikTok band carries the Under review flag, and its note states in full that "§3.6.1 prints this low end as 6.5% — under review, C-18". THAT NOTE IS WHY THE LITERAL STILL REACHES PRINT, verified by emulating print on /reach. Flagging the conflict preserved the printed figure that correcting it would have destroyed. See CONFLICTS.md C-18; lib/figures/figures.test.ts asserts both halves of the disagreement so it cannot be closed by accident.
